title: A Forest — Ukulele Song-Form Accompaniment
description: Playable, song-structured high-G ukulele accompaniment using the documented harmony and characteristic rhythmic feel of “A Forest”. Designed for practice, not a note-for-note original guitar, vocal, bass or lead-riff transcription.
body:
Instrumental introduction: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 3×)
Verse 1: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 4×)
Verse 2: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 4×)
Bridge: B | C | F#m | C | B | C (repeat 1×)
Instrumental break: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 3×)
Final verse: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 4×)
Outro vamp: Am | C | F | Dm (repeat 3×)
notes:
High-G GCEA, no capo; concert pitch. Hypnotic Am–C–F–Dm picking and contrasting chromatic B–C–F#m bridge.
Score section map: Instrumental introduction (1–12) · Verse 1 (13–28) · Verse 2 (29–44) · Bridge (45–50) · Instrumental break (51–62) · Final verse (63–78) · Outro vamp (79–90).
Original meter where supported; some rhythmic/meter details are adapted to the current single-meter, single-voice score engine. Rhythmic parts are original and song-characteristic, not copied riffs. Slash-bass/inversion details beyond the ukulele range are omitted.
Source harmonies: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_Forest
